hint_archive_root_html: Where the duplicate-free set of files is built. Only a small identifier, .akasyx/archive.id, is placed here (the database is in the “Data location” below).
pick_source: Choose the source file or folder
hint_source_html: Only files that are not duplicates are moved into the archive folder (duplicates stay here).
dry_run_html: Dry run (check only — nothing is moved and the database is not changed)
hint_destination_html: Files go into a year-month folder of their creation date (YYYY-MM/), keeping the source folder name and its subfolders. When a folder reaches the file limit, further files go into 001/, 002/, … subfolders.
folder_limit_label: Max. files placed directly in one folder
min_size_label: Minimum size in bytes (smaller files are not moved)
with_meta_html: Also extract format-specific metadata (the crawler needs --extra meta)
prune_empty_dirs_add_html: Delete source folders that become empty (folders that only contain .DS_Store count as empty)
hint_verify_html: Compares the files in the archive folder with the database. No files are moved.
flag_missing_html: missing — in the database, but the file is gone
flag_unregistered_html: unregistered — the file exists, but is not in the database
flag_hash_mismatch_html: hash_mismatch — the file's hash differs from the database
hint_delete_html: Deletes (or moves aside) the duplicates that add left in the source, after checking each one twice.
trash_dir_label: Move-aside folder (if set, files are moved here instead of deleted)
prune_empty_dirs_delete: Delete source folders that become empty
yes_html:
Really delete (--yes)
If unchecked, the check results are only listed
hint_report: Shows the state of the archive folder and the run history. Nothing is changed.
report_ingest_id_label: Show the details of a run (run ID)
data_dir_label: Data location (archive database, working database, logs)
hint_data_dir: This folder remains when you delete the app. The archive database is the record of what is in your archive folders, so include it in your backups. To remove everything, delete this folder too.
archive_db_label: Archive database (one file for all archive folders)
hint_archive_db: Keep it on a local disk, outside the archive folders. Archive folders are registered in this database by ID, so you can use several.
reopened_note: (The window was reopened. Earlier output is not shown, but the run is still going.)
status_stop_requested: Stop requested (waiting for the cleanup to finish)…
status_stopped: Stopped (the work done so far has been recorded)
env_bundled_missing: The bundled detector was not found ({dir}). Please reinstall the app.
env_dev_missing: detector/main.py was not found ({dir}). Place electron-ui directly under the repository root.
exit_2: Finished, but at least one item failed (please check the details)
exit_3: Rejected by the pre-run checks (nested folders, missing crawler, etc.)
bundled_detector_missing: The bundled detector was not found ({program}). Please reinstall the app.
uv_missing: uv was not found ({program}). Install uv, add it to PATH and try again.
busy: A run is in progress. Wait until it finishes or stop it.
delete_confirm_message: The duplicate files left in the source will be deleted
delete_confirm_detail:
Only files that passed the check are affected, but these source files will be lost.
If you set a move-aside folder (--trash-dir), they are moved there instead of deleted.
err_source_required: Choose the source (files or folder to add)
err_folder_limit: The folder file limit must be a whole number of 1 or more: {value}
err_min_size: The minimum size must be a whole number of 0 or more: {value}
err_ingest_id: The run ID must be a positive whole number: {value}
hint_adopt_html: Registers the files already in the archive folder (a folder that has files but no records, or one whose archive database was lost), so that add does not store duplicates of them. No files are moved. Duplicates inside the folder are reported as archive_duplicate.
hint_archives_html: Archive folders registered in the archive database. Duplicate detection covers all of them. If you deleted an archive folder, forget it here; otherwise files that were only in it are treated as duplicates and are stored nowhere.
archives_empty: No archive folders are registered yet.
archives_error:
Could not read the list of archive folders:
{detail}
forget_confirm_message: Stop using archive folder #{id} for duplicate detection?
forget_confirm_detail:
Do this only if you deleted the folder. Files that were stored only in it will be stored again by the next add.
If the folder was only disconnected, its records come back when you use it again.
err_forget_id: The archive folder ID must be a positive whole number: {value}
next_forget: Some duplicates are only in archive folders that are not connected. If you deleted them, forget them in Archive folders.
next_adopt: The files in this folder must be registered first: {path}
archives_timeout: Timed out (an archive folder on the network may not be responding).
err_forget_uid: The uid of the archive folder to forget is missing or invalid (reload the list of archive folders): {value}
archives_no_db: The archive database does not exist yet. It is created by the first run (such as Add).
